uncertain_post_replay.detail: publish writes verification-requested.json before the first verify call. If the HTTP POST result is uncertain and no verify-submit.json was saved, a future call stops with Reconcile prior POST before retry, preventing blind duplicate POST. If a submit receipt exists, the entire current request including source hash/explanation must equal the saved verify request; established verify then reuses the submission ID and resumes polling. Accepted verification followed by metadata failure also resumes from that existing submit receipt. The established protocol is imported by compiling only its verify function AST, so its historical top-level publishing code is not executed.

platform_mutation_bounds.detail: No new-node publication endpoint occurs. Fresh GET checks preserve target raw formal statement, private visibility and pinned environment, and refresh the two existing Proved dependency statuses. After ACCEPTED the script patches only natural-language/source metadata, rechecks the unchanged formal statement and Proved status, then fetches complete graph/frontier and checks the existing canonical-cusp parent.
